🐴 MY PONY FARM 🥕

Raise the cutest ponies, grow a mountain of carrots and build the richest farm on Roblox! 🌈

🐎 Buy ponies – they make 🥕 carrots for you!
✨ MERGE 3 ponies into 1 rarer pony!
🦄 Unlock 18 ponies: Unicorn, Pegasus, Fairy, Angel, Dream & more!
💵 Sell your carrots at the shop for CASH!
📈 Watch the market – sell when prices hit 2X!
🎁 Open Lucky Boxes: Wooden, Leaf, Silver, Golden & Ice!
🏇 Ride your favorite pony around the farm!
📖 Collect them all in the Pony Index!
💤 Earn carrots even while you're offline!
👫 +10% cash for every friend in your server!
🏆 Climb the global leaderboards!

👍 LIKE & ⭐ FAVORITE for more updates!
👥 Join Dojo Empire and claim FREE cash every 10 minutes!
